content.rationale: The restore half of undo and redo is where each model's transition meets the write half: specs/markers/undo.qnt (nrqwpwkq) fixes that undo's position is the pre-boundary of the most recent applied pair, and specs/markers/redo.qnt (zovzqmon) that redo's is the post-boundary of the next undone pair, and the invocation restores that position through the restore module. This check drives the two handlers over a scratch jj workspace whose marker file names real operation ids read from the op log, and pins that each invocation lands the repo on the boundary its model names and writes that model's state, the pairs standing. It reaches the marker file through M-markers-persist, so it is a crate of its own. I1-serde (orrvsxqq) fixes the JSON layer the crate is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive — and I1-schema (zmmyomyp) fixes the validator these documents are checked with.
